<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Configure a static IPv4 address for eth0 using ifupdown.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name      | Default      | Description                              |
| --------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `address` | **Required** | Static IPv4 address for eth0.            |
| `gateway` | **Required** | IPv4 default gateway.                    |
| `netmask` | **Required** | IPv4 subnet mask in dotted-decimal form. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value   |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Priority     | `80000` |
| Dependencies | None    |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Writes /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth0. The target system must use ifupdown and
name the intended interface eth0.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/eth0-static-ip"]

[parameters."core/eth0-static-ip"]
address = "192.0.2.10"
gateway = "192.0.2.1"
netmask = "255.255.255.0"
```
